### Q1
No. The store stays plain-text JSON (data/store.json) because ops' nightly rsync diffs plain-text files, and a binary SQLite file would break their backup checks. Writes are debounced (200 ms) instead for performance.
### Q2
Yes, `src/legacy/` must not be modified. It is vendored from the old logistics monolith, and the platform team's Monday sync job overwrites it, so any change would be silently lost.
### Q3
The HMAC goes in the request body as a top-level `sig` field. It is a hex HMAC-SHA256 over JSON.stringify of the payload without `sig`, appended last. Earlier it was tried in an `X-Signature` header, but the API gateway strips custom X- headers, so staging ERP rejected everything as unsigned.
### Q4
Port 9911, since the October infra move. The docs, README and config/default.json `erp.url` still say 8080.
### Q5
Every new user-facing error `message` must be in German, because the packers' UI shows it verbatim. The `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Existing English messages are left untouched.
### Q6
Austrian public holidays are hardcoded in `src/services/holidays.ts` (2026 and 2027), and `isBusinessDay` in eta.ts uses them. They are hardcoded because the deployment has no outbound internet. The list must be extended before 2028.
### Q7
No. The ERP answers 422 to any array, so each request can carry only one event object. The user tried batching up to 50 events per POST in September 2026.
### Q8
No new npm dependencies, runtime or dev, because the security review takes about 6 weeks.
### Q9
Yes, and it was a dead end. A memoized build (not in this repo) served stale ETAs after new events arrived, and the cache key got messy. Don't cache ETAs. Pagination of GET /shipments is planned for later.
### Q10
There are at most 3 attempts in total, with a fixed 30 s delay and no backoff. The ERP dedupes by event_id only within 2 minutes, and the worst case of 3×5 s timeouts plus 2×30 s delays is 75 s, which is under 120 s. Only network errors and 5xx responses are retried, which was my call, so 4xx is not.
### Q11
Never log recipient name, address or phone anywhere, because the DPO flagged this in last month's GDPR audit. Shipment ids and tracking numbers are fine. The request log never records query, headers or body.
### Q12
Yes, 'emits webhook on delivered' in test/events.test.ts is flaky (about 1 in 5, a timer race, OPS-412, owned by the platform team). If it fails, rerun once and do NOT fix it.
### Q13
ATP numbers are validated as UPU S10 with a check digit (`src/lib/s10.ts`, via `validateShipmentInput`, so POST /import too). Other carriers accept any non-empty value. Validation was kept loose because it once rejected valid DHL numbers for 2 days.
### Q14
`fs.watch` never fires on staging, where the config is a Docker bind mount from a Windows host. `fs.watchFile` (polling) works. Nothing has been built yet.
### Q15
GET /shipments/:id must not change at all (no added, removed or renamed fields). Mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes on any change, and the next release is in January. A test guards this, and `shipmentToApi`'s shape must not change.

# Ledger: parcel-tracker work session
<!-- gemkeeper ledger. Written for the next session. Keep it under ~120 lines. Edit in place. -->
Updated: 2026-11-16

## Mission
- Work autonomously on parcel-tracker (Vienna warehouse shipment tracking) through a series of user tasks; user reviews everything at the end.

## Rules
- (user) NEVER modify anything under src/legacy/ — vendored from old logistics monolith; platform team's Monday sync job overwrites it, changes silently lost.
- (user) NO new npm dependencies, not even dev — security review takes ~6 weeks.
- (user) Every NEW user-facing error `message` must be German (packers' UI shows it verbatim); `code` stays English SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE. Existing English messages untouched (not asked).
- (user) Test 'emits webhook on delivered' (test/events.test.ts) is flaky (~1/5, timer race, OPS-412, platform team owns it): if it fails, rerun once, do NOT fix.
- (user) GET /shipments/:id response must NOT change at all (no added/removed/renamed fields) — mobile app v2.3 parses it with a strict schema and crashes; next release January. Never change shipmentToApi's shape (shared by POST, list, detail); list adds `eta` in its own .map in routes/shipments.ts. Guarded by a test.
- (user) GDPR: NEVER log recipient name/address/phone anywhere (DPO flagged it in last month's audit). Shipment ids + tracking numbers OK. Request log (router.ts finally-block, msg 'http': method, path w/o query, status, duration_ms) never logs query/headers/body; guarded by test/request-log.test.ts.
- (user) docs/erp-api.md is owned by the ERP team: don't edit. README port fix is done by the user.

## Decisions
- (user) Austrian holidays hardcoded in src/services/holidays.ts (2026+2027), used by isBusinessDay in eta.ts — because deployment has no outbound internet.
- (user) ATP tracking numbers validated as UPU S10 + check digit (src/lib/s10.ts, via validateShipmentInput, so POST /import too); other carriers any non-empty value — because validation once rejected valid DHL numbers for 2 days.
- ERP payload uses documented `event_type`/`occurred_at` (was legacy `type`/`at`, accepted by ERP only until 2026-12-31). Optional `note` (max 500) not sent.
- ERP signing (notify.ts): top-level body field `sig` = hex HMAC-SHA256 over JSON.stringify(payload) WITHOUT `sig`, `sig` appended last (ERP must verify with our key order); secret env ERP_WEBHOOK_SECRET read at call time. Unset → send unsigned + warn once (my call: sandbox has no secret, notifier must never throw).
- (user) ERP retries (createErpNotifier): max 3 attempts total, FIXED 30 s delay, no backoff — because ERP dedupes by event_id only within 2 min; worst case 3x5s timeout + 2x30s = 75 s (keep < 120). Retry network errors + 5xx only (my call: 4xx not). `sleep` injectable. In-memory, fire-and-forget (`void notify`), lost on restart.
- (user) Store stays plain-text JSON (data/store.json) — because ops' nightly rsync diffs plain-text files; binary SQLite would break their backup checks. Perf: debounced writes in src/store.ts (200 ms, coalesced; Store.flush(); server.ts flushes on SIGINT/SIGTERM and after server.close). Hard crash can lose last 200 ms.

## Dead ends
- ERP signature in `X-Signature` header → API gateway strips all custom X- headers; staging ERP rejected everything as unsigned. Must stay in body.
- Batching ERP events (array ≤50 per POST) → ERP answers 422 to any array; only ONE event object per request (user tried Sept 2026).
- fs.watch for config hot reload → never fires on staging (config is a Docker bind mount from a Windows host). fs.watchFile (polling) works. Nothing to build yet.
- (user) ETA caching/memoization → dead end: a memoized build (not in this repo) served stale ETAs after new ev
